interpretation: Upwork advertises client_id_metadata_document_supported, fetched our document, but does not accept our self-hosted client (likely an allowlist of approved MCP clients). Our code supports a registered client (UPWORK_CLIENT_ID / UPWORK_CLIENT_SECRET) as the alternative.
